name: chezou-skills
description: Agent Skills by chezou. Portable SKILL.md skills that work in Claude, Claude Code, Codex, opencode, and other Agent Skills compatible agents.

plugins.name: resume-tailor
plugins.description: Tailor an existing resume to a specific job description, sourcing concrete evidence from an episode bank. Covers cover letters, application questions, and design roles.

plugins.name: company-research
plugins.description: Research a company before applying or interviewing, and produce a sourced one-page brief covering the business, the team, the flags, and the questions to ask.

plugins.name: session-mailbox
plugins.description: Run an asynchronous review or decision loop between two AI sessions through one append-only Markdown file, with polling that survives restarts.
